_comment: Reviewer-approved corrections to etiology gold, applied as a scoring-time overlay so the canonical approved-outputs fixture (and its payload hashes / writeback authority) stay intact. Each entry replaces the etiologies for that item_id. Canonical writeback is a separate, sign-off-gated step.

abnormal_right_paratracheal_stripe.reason: descriptive finding; the curator pasted infectious+malignant differential. Agent right to omit.

fetal_chest_mass.reason: indeterminate mass -> neoplastic:potential, not benign+malignant+formation (avoid malignancy over-call).

infratentorial_intracranial_tumor_in_a_c.reason: indeterminate tumor -> neoplastic:potential (reviewer ruling), consistent with the indeterminate-mass rule; not benign+malignant+potential and not the over-lenient bare parent.

abnormal_sternomanubrial_synchondrosis.reason: reviewer ruled the agent 'correct enough' (formation anomaly; developmental/congenital or blank acceptable). Encoded so the heavier over-reach penalty does not wrongly ding it.

breast_soft_tissue_lesion.reason: indeterminate lesion -> neoplastic:potential (was blank; agent's benign+malignant also wrong).

breast_calcification_cluster.reason: cluster can flag malignancy -> neoplastic:potential (was blank).

pneumonia.reason: single most-specific label (pneumonia is infectious), not parent+child.

pediatric_chest_wall_lesion.reason: indeterminate mass/lesion -> neoplastic:potential (gold was blank); agent's call is correct under the indeterminate-mass rule.

t2_hyperintense_renal_mass.reason: indeterminate renal mass -> neoplastic:potential (gold was blank); agent's call is correct under the indeterminate-mass rule.
